lines.en: Moves slowly, not in a hurry.
Wriggles in the sand, seeking treasures.

lines.zh: 小螯在泥里刨出一个小坑。
lines.en: My small claws scoop a little pit in the mud.

lines.zh: 我横着挪，像一片会走的壳。
lines.en: I sidle along like a walking shell.
I follow the tide line, picking wet mud.

lines.zh: 壳边蹭过礁石，发出细响。
lines.en: My shell edge rasps the rock.

lines.zh: 我用小螯筛着湿沙找碎屑。
lines.en: I sift the wet sand with my small claws for scraps.
The swamp water only reaches my shell top.

lines.zh: 我一边走，一边筛泥找虫。
lines.en: As I walk, I sift mud for microbes.
Lays still, basking in the sun.

lines.zh: 在岸边晒太阳，慢慢享受。

lines.en: Relaxes, basking in the sun slowly.

lines.zh: 眼柄转了一圈，没什么动静。
lines.en: My eye stalks sweep once; nothing stirs.

lines.zh: 壳缝里卡着一粒沙，我抖了抖。
lines.en: A grain sticks in my shell seam; I shake it.
The tide is out; I lie still.

lines.zh: 我把小螯收在壳下，歇一会儿。
lines.en: I tuck my claws under the shell and rest.

lines.zh: 软壳破了，我挖不动泥了。
lines.en: My soft shell is torn; I cannot dig the mud.
There's bone in the sand — I dug it up.

lines.zh: 我在这沙子里找到金粒！
这片烂叶下全是小虫，来吃。
lines.en: Under this rotten leaf are tiny bugs — come eat.
Found some lines in the mud!
Don't bump into me, I have small eyes!

lines.zh: 别靠这么近，我壳薄得很。
lines.en: Don't come so close; my shell is thin.

lines.zh: 我从泥沙里翻出一粒金。
lines.en: I turn up a grain of gold from the silt.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的眼柄，我缩回壳。
lines.en: You step on my eye stalk, and I pull into my shell.
Don't get close to my burrow!
You're too loud, I need to rest!

lines.zh: 沼泽水暖了，正适合产卵。
lines.en: The swamp water has warmed — good for laying eggs.
We're the same, mate with me!

lines.zh: 我的卵可以孵化新生命！
lines.en: My eggs can hatch new life!

lines.zh: 哦哦哦哦哦！”，在沙泥中挖掘出一枚金粒。
lines.en: Oh oh oh oh! Found a golden grain in the mud.

lines.zh: 这里埋着点什么？竟然找到了一截恐龙骨头！
lines.en: What’s buried here? A dinosaur bone fragment!

lines.zh: 哦哦哦哦哦！竟然挖出了一块铁！
lines.en: Oh oh oh oh! Found some iron!

lines.zh: 嘿！这个能做不错的装饰哦！
lines.en: Hey! This would make a nice decoration.

lines.zh: 这微生物真好吃，让我饱餐一顿吧。
lines.en: These microbes taste good, let me feast.

lines.zh: 哇哦，好大的微生物！”，边吃边叫。
lines.en: Wow, such big microbes! Eating and calling.

lines.zh: 哦哦哦哦哦！发现了微小的线，看起来不错。
lines.en: Oh oh oh oh! Found some small threads, look nice.

lines.zh: 这里的食物丰富，让我安心居住吧。
lines.en: The food here is abundant, I’ll settle here.

lines.zh: 咦，这泥土下可能有更多宝藏！
lines.en: Huh, more treasures might be under this mud!

lines.zh: 哦哦哦哦哦！这里埋着珍贵的金粒。
lines.en: Oh oh oh oh! A precious golden grain is buried here.

lines.zh: 哦哦哦哦哦！它看起来像只小鱼，我要尝试捕捉。
lines.en: Oh oh oh oh! It looks like a small fish, I’ll try to catch it.

lines.zh: 哦哦哦哦哦！找到目标了，准备享用午餐。
lines.en: Oh oh oh oh! Target acquired, lunch time.

lines.zh: 哦哦哦哦哦！它游得真快，追不上了。
lines.en: Oh oh oh oh! It swims so fast, can’t catch it.

lines.zh: 哦哦哦哦哦！这微生物聚在一起了，我要吃了。
lines.en: Oh oh oh oh! Those microbes gathered, time to eat.

lines.zh: 哦哦哦哦哦！那是什么，看起来像是条小鱼。
lines.en: Oh oh oh oh! What is that? Looks like a small fish.

lines.zh: 哦哦哦哦哦！终于靠近了，准备享用美味。
lines.en: Oh oh oh oh! Finally close, time for a delicious meal.

lines.zh: 哦哦哦哦哦！这条小鱼游得太快了，追不上。
lines.en: Oh oh oh oh! This fish swims too fast, can’t catch it.

lines.zh: 哦哦哦哦哦！这微生物太少了，追不上。
lines.en: Oh oh oh oh! Too few microbes, can’t catch them.

lines.zh: 哦哦哦哦哦！那是什么，看起来像是只小鱼。
lines.en: Oh oh oh oh! What is that? Looks like a small fish.

lines.zh: 哦哦哦哦哦！终于捉住了，享受美食吧。
lines.en: Oh oh oh oh! Finally got it, time for a feast.

lines.zh: 哦哦哦哦哦！锁定目标，准备攻击。
lines.en: Oh oh oh oh! Targeting, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 哦哦哦哦哦！锁定目标，等待最佳时机。
lines.en: Oh oh oh oh! Targeting, waiting for the best moment.

lines.zh: 哦哦哦哦哦！目标已锁定，现在可以行动了。
lines.en: Oh oh oh oh! Target locked, now action.

lines.zh: 哦哦哦哦哦！锁定目标，准备释放能量。
lines.en: Oh oh oh oh! Targeting, ready to release energy.

lines.zh: 哦哦哦哦哦！锁定目标，等待攻击指令。
lines.en: Oh oh oh oh! Targeting, waiting for the attack command.

lines.zh: 哦哦哦哦哦！锁定目标，准备进行攻击。
lines.en: Oh oh oh oh! Targeting, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 哦哦哦哦哦！锁定目标，准备释放攻击。
lines.en: Oh oh oh oh! Targeting, ready to release the attack.

lines.zh: 哦哦哦哦哦！锁定目标，现在可以攻击了。
lines.en: Oh oh oh oh! Target locked, now attack.

lines.zh: 哦哦哦哦哦！锁定目标，准备发射攻击。
lines.en: Oh oh oh oh! Targeting, ready to launch the attack.

lines.zh: 哦哦哦哦哦！锁定目标，现在可以进行攻击了。
lines.en: Oh oh oh oh! Target locked, now attack.

lines.zh: 淤泥翻起，我从洞里钻出来。
lines.en: The silt turns and I come out of my burrow.

lines.zh: 晚侏罗世的浅滩，多了只小甲壳。
lines.en: One more small crustacean on a Jurassic flat.

lines.zh: 火烤干了我的壳，鳃也焦了。
lines.en: Fire dries my shell and scorches my gills.

lines.zh: 泥水堵住鳃，我翻了个身。
lines.en: Mud clogs my gills, and I roll over.
My shell cracked; silt seeps in.

lines.zh: 泥里翻不出吃的，螯都抬不动。
lines.en: Nothing edible in the mud, and my claws won't lift.
